integrity: Original results are the sharp necessity criterion and the power-law energy/variance constants; the exact source kernel formula and orthogonal interaction identity are credited to Sun (2026). Finite checks do not prove asymptotic or originality claims.
limitations: The necessity and exact constants cover additive singleton-interaction ANOVA kernels with a Gaussian radial seed and the specified bandwidth rule; not arbitrary higher interactions, other kernels, or alternative approximation algorithms. The sampling identity concerns independent uniform points and constant input. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp summability and three-regime sampling noise for Gaussian additive ANOVA kernels
